info.title: Task Service API
info.description: Task Service HTTP APIs. Request body examples use Metadata Registry value codes (see open-api.yaml). Operational fields (currentState, surfaceSection, runtimeTaskSource) use camelCase.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT from the identity provider.

TaskBehaviorCode.description: Metadata Registry TaskBehaviorCode value code. Authoritative list from registry; persisted verbatim.

patientId.description: Patient id from request body (not from JWT).

patientDisplayName.description: Patient display name from request body (not from JWT).

assignedToStaffId.description: Staff user id when assignedToType is staff; drives GSI1 staff inbox.

AssignedToType.description: Metadata Registry AssignedToType value code. Non-patient assignee GSI1 is ORG#<orgId>#STAFF#<assigneeId>; assignedToType is stored on META only.

CurrentState.description: API wire uses open for in-progress tasks; active/scheduled are legacy persistence values normalized to open on read.

staffUserId.description: Present when staffUserId query param was provided for in-patient staff bucket filtering.

staffTasks.description: Populated only when staffUserId query param is provided; otherwise items is empty.

patientId.description: Patient id from request body (not from JWT).

patientDisplayName.description: Patient display name from request body (not from JWT).

assignedToStaffId.description: Staff user id when assignedToType is staff; drives GSI1 staff inbox.

example.description: Follow up on missed BP reading from yesterday

patientId.description: Patient id from request body (not from JWT).

patientDisplayName.description: Patient display name from request body (not from JWT).

ExampleRuntimeTaskCard.description: Sample runtime task card used in response examples.

post.description: Called by Monitoring Runtime. orgId from JWT; patientId and patientDisplayName from request body.

post.summary: Generate care-plan linkage runtime tasks (idempotent batch)
post.description: Called by Care Plan Runtime. orgId from JWT; patientId and patientDisplayName from request body.

200.description: Batch generate results (created or skipped duplicate per linkage).

get.description: Full task context for detail views. Organization scope is from JWT; task must belong to the caller's org.

patch.description: Portal partial metadata edit on META (+ LOOKUP when patientDisplayName changes). Appends HIST taskMetadataChange audit.

200.description: Updated task metadata and audit entry.

put.summary: Assign or reassign staff task to a staff member
put.description: Portal assign/reassign for staff tasks. Initial assignment sets assignedToStaffId plus GSI1 (gsi1Pk and gsi1Sk); reassignment updates gsi1Pk only. Appends HIST assignedToStaffChange audit. Organization scope from JWT only.

422.description: Not a staff task or already assigned to this staff member

get.description: Paged append-only HIST# timeline for one runtime task (newest first). Organization scope is from JWT.

get.summary: List tasks by patient and (optionally) care plan
get.description: Patient-scoped task list for Mobile, Portal, or BFF. Organization scope from JWT only.

parameters.name: staffUserId
parameters.description: When set, staff-assigned tasks for this staff member appear in staffTasks; patientTasks excludes all staff-assigned tasks.

200.description: Patient-scoped task list split into patientTasks and staffTasks buckets.

post.description: Called by Service Flow Runtime or authorized staff/system. orgId from JWT; patientId and patientDisplayName from request body. GSI1 when assignedToStaffId set.

x-example.description: Follow up on missed BP reading from yesterday

get.summary: Get Action Center items by surface section
get.description: Patient Action Center with server-derived surfaceSection. Mobile/Portal must render the returned section — do not re-bucket Today vs Upcoming client-side.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone for calendar Today (default UTC).

200.description: Action Center grouped or single-section response.

get.summary: List tasks assigned to the authenticated staff member
get.description: Staff inbox via GSI1. staffUserId must match JWT user id. Defaults to excluding terminal states when currentState is omitted.

403.description: Forbidden — staffUserId must match authenticated user

200.description: Updated reminder settings and audit entry.

get.summary: Get care plan task readiness/status summary
